rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N serves as the primary table identifier and one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty; missing values would break referential integrity

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N is designated as a unique identifier (30 distinct values in 30 records); duplicates indicate data corruption

rule: Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N; referential integrity must be enforced before joining

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers ranging from 1001-1028; values must conform to this fixed-width numeric format

rule: Account_No should be unique (flag duplicates for investigation)
rationale: Account numbers should uniquely identify accounts; duplicates (1001, 1010 observed) require clarification as they may indicate data entry errors or valid repeated entries

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Customer name is mandatory for identity verification and communication

rule: Name must use Title Case format (not all lowercase or all uppercase)
rationale: Sample shows dominant Title Case convention with deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lower) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all upper); standardisation required for consistent display and matching

check_params.logic: any((w.islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','s/o','d/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID/Foreign Identification Number is mandatory for identity verification in Singapore context

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow format aXXXXXXXa (e.g., S8403757E); anomalies detected include '1916569C' (missing prefix) and 'F212233V' (6 digits instead of 7)

rule: ID_No must be unique
rationale: National ID numbers should uniquely identify individuals; duplicate 'F1011121T' observed requires investigation

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic field for this dataset

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Observed values map to three semantic categories with casing inconsistencies (MALAY, malay, indian); standardising to Title Case canonical forms

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female (Title Case)
rationale: Observed variations include 'male' and 'FEMALE'; standardising to Title Case canonical forms

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory demographic field

rule: Age must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Non-numeric text value 'Twenty-five' detected (3.3% of records); values must be numeric for calculations and range validation

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 years inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for human age; observed value -5 is implausible and must be flagged

rule: Age must be at least 13 years for service accounts
rationale: Values below 13 (observed: 4, -5) are unrealistic for a consumer service account and likely indicate data entry errors

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is mandatory for customer communication; 6.7% missing values observed in sample require flagging

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, optional +65 or 65 prefix)
rationale: Singapore phone numbers are 8 digits with country code 65; observed formats include '+65 ', '65 ', and raw 8-digit; one 7-digit value '8964359' appears truncated

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is mandatory for digital communication and account management

rule: Email must contain a single @ symbol with no whitespace (format: local@domain)
rationale: 4 structurally malformed emails detected (13.3%): 'not-an-email' (no @), 'zx91 @example.com' (space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @), 'useremail.com' (no @)

rule: Email must be unique
rationale: Email addresses should uniquely identify customers; duplicate 'thm@example.com' observed requires investigation

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is mandatory for address validation and regulatory compliance

rule: Country must be the canonical value 'Singapore'
rationale: 8 distinct representations observed (Singapore, SINGAPORE, singapore, S'pore, SG, Republic of Singapore, Singapura, 新加坡); all represent Singapore and must be standardised to canonical English form

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory component of the address

rule: Street_Name must use Title Case format (not all uppercase)
rationale: 96.7% of values use Title Case; one deviation 'HOLLAND ROAD' (all caps) requires standardisation

check_params.logic: any((w.islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address validation and mail delivery

rule: Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits (Singapore standard)
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits; observed values include 4-digit (6907) and 5-digit (99999) lengths suggesting missing leading zeros or data entry errors

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use patronymic particles that encode gender: 'Bin' and 's/o' indicate male; 'Binte' and 'd/o' indicate female; inconsistencies suggest data errors

check_params.logic:
import re
name = str(row['Name'])
gender = str(row['Gender']).strip().lower()
male_match = re.search(r'\b(bin|s/o)\b', name, re.IGNORECASE)
female_match = re.search(r'\b(binte|d/o)\b', name, re.IGNORECASE)
(male_match and gender != 'male') or (female_match and gender != 'female')

rule: ID_No must match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one join key between tables; the national identification number must be consistent across both tables for the same customer to ensure identity integrity

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must equal ID for matching S_N values

rule: Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one join key; account number must be consistent across biographical and account information tables

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No must equal Account_No for matching S_N values

rule: Name must match the corresponding Full_Name value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (accounting for standardisation)
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one join key; customer name should be consistent across Cust_Bio_dirty and Acc_Info_dirty tables, allowing for case differences but requiring semantic equivalence

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name for matching S_N values
